description_en: A scheduled task is a preset node. You can invoke the CreateScheduledTask API operation to create a scheduled task that executes a specified scaling rule at a specified time, which automatically scales compute resources to meet business requirements and control costs
description_zh: 定时任务是一种预设任务，您可以通过调用API CreateScheduledTask创建一个定时任务，在指定时间执行指定伸缩规则，实现计算资源的自动扩张或收缩，来满足业务需求的同时又能控制成本
kebab_example: aliyun ess create-scheduled-task --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --scheduled-task-name 'scheduled****' --description 'Test scheduled task.' --scheduled-action 'ari:acs:ess:cn-hangzhou:140692647****:scalingrule/asr-bp12tcnol686y1ik****' --recurrence-end-time 2014-08-17T16:55Z --launch-time 2014-08-17T16:52Z --recurrence-type Daily --recurrence-value 1 --task-enabled true --launch-expiration-time 600 --min-value 0 --max-value 10 --desired-capacity 10 --scaling-group-id 'asg-bp18p2yfxow2dloq****' --api-version 2022-02-22 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateScheduledTask

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region to which the scheduled task belongs
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the scheduled task. The name must be 2 to 64 characters in length. It must start with a letter, digit, or Chinese character, and can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), hyphens (-), and periods (.). The name must be unique within the same region and Alibaba Cloud account.

Default value: the value of ScheduledTaskId
parameters.help_zh:
定时任务的名称。2~64个英文或中文字符，以数字、大小字母或中文开头，可包含数字、下划线（_）、短划线（-）或半角句号（.）。同一账号同一地域内唯一。 

默认值为`ScheduledTaskId`的值
parameters.name: scheduled_task_name

parameters.help_en: The description of the scheduled task. The description must be 2 to 200 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 定时任务的描述信息，长度为2~200个英文或中文字符
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the scaling rule to be executed when the scheduled task is triggered. After you specify ScheduledAction, the scaling method of the scheduled task is set to selecting an existing scaling rule. You cannot specify both ScheduledAction and ScalingGroupId at the same time
parameters.help_zh:
定时任务触发时需要执行的伸缩规则，填写伸缩规则的唯一标识符。

指定`ScheduledAction`后，定时任务的伸缩方式为选择已有伸缩规则。不支持同时设置`ScheduledAction`和`ScalingGroupId`
parameters.name: scheduled_action

parameters.help_en: The end time of the scheduled task that is executed repeatedly. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC. You cannot specify a time that is later than 365 days from the date of creation
parameters.help_zh:
重复执行定时任务的结束时间。按照ISO8601标准表示，并需要使用UTC时间。

格式为：YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ。不能填写自创建当天起365日后的时间
parameters.name: recurrence_end_time

parameters.help_en:
The time at which the scheduled task is triggered. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC. You cannot specify a time that is later than 90 days from the date of creation. 
If RecurrenceType is specified, the time specified by this parameter defaults to the time when the task is executed repeatedly.
If RecurrenceType is not specified, the task is executed once at the specified date and time
parameters.help_zh:
定时任务触发的时间点。 按照ISO8601标准表示，并需要使用UTC时间。格式为：YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ。不能填写自创建当天起90日后的时间。 

如果指定了`RecurrenceType`，则此属性指定的时间点，默认为循环执行的时间点。

如果未指定`RecurrenceType`，则按指定的日期和时间执行一次
parameters.name: launch_time

parameters.help_en:
The recurrence type of the scheduled task. Valid values: 
Daily: The scheduled task is executed once every specified number of days. 
Weekly: The scheduled task is executed on specified days of each week. 
Monthly: The scheduled task is executed on specified days of each month. 
Cron: The scheduled task is executed based on the specified cron expression. 
You must specify both RecurrenceType and RecurrenceValue
parameters.help_zh:
重复执行定时任务的类型，取值范围： 
Daily：每多少天重复执行一次定时任务。 
Weekly：每周指定几天重复执行一次定时任务。 
Monthly：每月内指定几天重复执行一次定时任务。 
Cron：按照指定的Cron表达式执行定时任务。 

您需要同时指定`RecurrenceType`和`RecurrenceValue`。
parameters.name: recurrence_type

parameters.help_en:
The recurrence value of the scheduled task. 
If RecurrenceType is set to Daily, you can specify only one value. Valid values: 1 to 31. 
If RecurrenceType is set to Weekly, you can specify multiple values separated by commas (,). For example, the values for Sunday, Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, and Saturday are 0,1,2,3,4,5,6.  
If RecurrenceType is set to Monthly, the format is A-B. Valid values of A and B: 1 to 31. B must be greater than or equal to A. 
If RecurrenceType is set to Cron, the value represents UTC time and supports a five-field expression for minutes, hours, days, months, and days of the week. The expression supports wildcards such as commas (,), question marks (?), hyphens (-), asterisks (*), number signs (#), forward slashes (/), L, and W.  
You must specify both RecurrenceType and RecurrenceValue
parameters.help_zh:
重复执行定时任务的数值。 

`RecurrenceType`取值为`Daily`时，只能填一个值，取值范围：1~31。 
`RecurrenceType`取值为`Weekly`时，可以填入多个值，填多个值时使用半角逗号（,）分隔。例如，周日、周一、周二、周三、周四、周五、周六的值依次为：`0,1,2,3,4,5,6`。  
`RecurrenceType`取值为`Monthly`时，格式为`A-B`。A、B的取值范围为1~31，并且B必须大于等于A。 
`RecurrenceType`取值为`Cron`时，表示UTC时间，支持分、时、日、月、星期的五个域表达式，支持通配符半角逗号（,）、半角问号（?）、短划线（-）、星号（*）、井号（#）、正斜线（/）、L和W。  

您需要同时指定`RecurrenceType`和`RecurrenceValue`
parameters.name: recurrence_value

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to start the scheduled task. Valid values: 
true: starts the task.
false: stops the task.
Default value: true
parameters.help_zh:
是否启动定时任务。 
true：启动任务。
false：停止任务 。

默认值：true
parameters.name: task_enabled

parameters.help_en:
The period within which the scheduled task retries after a trigger failure. Unit: seconds. Valid values: 0 to 1800.
Default value: 600
parameters.help_zh:
定时任务触发操作失败后，在此时间内重试。单位为秒，取值范围：0~1800。

默认值：600
parameters.name: launch_expiration_time

parameters.help_en: The minimum number of instances in the scaling group when the scaling method of the scheduled task is set to specifying the number of instances in the scaling group
parameters.help_zh: 定时任务的伸缩方式为设置伸缩组内实例数量时，指定伸缩组内实例的最小数量
parameters.name: min_value

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of instances in the scaling group when the scaling method of the scheduled task is set to specifying the number of instances in the scaling group
parameters.help_zh: 定时任务的伸缩方式为设置伸缩组内实例数量时，指定伸缩组内实例的最大数量
parameters.name: max_value

parameters.help_en:
The expected number of instances in the scaling group when the scaling method of the scheduled task is set to specifying the number of instances in the scaling group.
The scaling group must support setting the expected number of instances. This means that DesiredCapacity must be specified when the scaling group is created
parameters.help_zh:
定时任务的伸缩方式为设置伸缩组内实例数量时，指定伸缩组内实例的期望实例数。

伸缩组必须支持设置期望实例数，即在创建该伸缩组时指定了`DesiredCapacity`
parameters.name: desired_capacity

parameters.help_en: The ID of the scaling group in which the number of instances is modified when the scheduled task is triggered. After you specify ScalingGroupId, the scaling method of the scheduled task is set to specifying the number of instances in the scaling group. You must specify a value for at least one of the MinValue, MaxValue, and DesiredCapacity parameters. You cannot specify both ScheduledAction and ScalingGroupId at the same time
parameters.help_zh:
定时任务触发时需要修改实例数量的伸缩组，填写伸缩组ID。

指定`ScalingGroupId`后，定时任务的伸缩方式为设置伸缩组内实例数量，您需要为`MinValue`、`MaxValue`和`DesiredCapacity`中至少一个参数指定数量。不支持同时设置`ScheduledAction`和`ScalingGroupId`
parameters.name: scaling_group_id

parameters.help_en: 伸缩组预热池容量配置，只有伸缩组配置了预热池时才有效
parameters.help_zh: 伸缩组预热池容量配置，只有伸缩组配置了预热池时才有效
parameters.name: warm_pool_capacity_options

ScheduledTaskId.description_en: The ID of the scheduled task. The ID is generated by the system and is globally unique
ScheduledTaskId.description_zh: 定时任务的ID，由系统生成，全局唯一
